## What I do (services)

- React and TypeScript web applications with accessible interfaces, robust data flows, and production-ready delivery
- React Native apps for iOS and Android with offline sync, push notifications, and reliable releases
- Node.js and TypeScript APIs, real-time services, workers, and third-party integrations
- Production-grade Laravel apps (queue workers, event-driven, DDD)
- Multi-tenant SaaS with billing, RBAC, audit trails, zero-downtime deploys
- REST & GraphQL APIs (OAuth2, rate limiting, OpenAPI specs)
- n8n automation, MCP agents, orchestration pipelines
- VoIP & call centers on Asterisk / FreePBX (IVR, predictive dialers, SIP)
- Real-time systems (Laravel Reverb, WebSockets, Pusher, Socket.IO)
- AI integrations: RAG pipelines (Pinecone, pgvector), LangChain, Claude, GPT-4

## Services

- [Laravel Development](https://www.chaudharyusama.com/services/laravel-development): Senior Laravel development for multi-tenant SaaS, APIs, queues, and billing. Production-grade PHP and MySQL architecture with tests, CI/CD, and handover.
- [VoIP & Asterisk](https://www.chaudharyusama.com/services/voip-asterisk): Asterisk and FreePBX call platforms: predictive dialers, IVR trees, SIP trunk failover, call recording, and CRM integration built on Laravel backends.
- [Automation Infrastructure](https://www.chaudharyusama.com/services/automation-n8n): n8n workflow automation and custom pipelines that replace manual back-office work. Reliable integrations, retries, monitoring, and Laravel-backed business logic.
- [AI Integration](https://www.chaudharyusama.com/services/ai-integration): Practical AI integration: RAG over your own data, LLM-backed support and agent workflows, streaming APIs, cost control, and evaluation, wired into Laravel backends.
